title: feat(lint)!: judge a lookupFilters { $record } path against the record being edited and its one hop
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9WV3Yir4VrA2jb8hKQX1jAw)_

Fixes #34200

Clause-②: no (narrowing) — a `lookupFilters[].value` `{ $record }` path on a lookup, master_detail or user field that names no field of the object owning that field, hops through a field that is not a relationship, names a leaf the referenced object lacks, or takes a second hop, parsed clean and published; it is now refused at error as `object-field-ref-unknown` by `os lint`, `os validate`, `os build` and the runtime publish door, and reported (never refused) on the package publish receipt's object probe.
Metadata-protocol: narrowed
Skills-docs: follow-up #34201 — no doc or skill teaches `{ $record }` yet (its picker reader has not landed; both describes carry `[PLANNED — not enforced]`), so there is no teaching to correct here.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：查找字段的 `lookupFilters` 里写 `{ $record: "路径" }`（读取正在编辑的记录）时，lint 现在会核对路径：第一段必须是本对象的字段；有第二段时第一段必须是关系字段（lookup / master_detail / user / tree）、第二段必须是它指向对象的字段；超过一跳直接拒。
- 为什么改：上一张卡只校验了路径的拼写格式，`acount.cb_market` 这类拼错的路径能顺利发布，要等选择器运行时才会悄悄失效。
- 风险与回滚：只收紧一条 lint 规则（同一规则 id `object-field-ref-unknown` 的新成员）；一方 examples / 平台对象 / skills / 文档样例里实测 0 处 `$record`，无存量受影响。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/lint/src/validate-object-field-refs.ts`（新的 `lookupFilters` `$record` 槽位与一跳上限那段循环）、`packages/lint/src/validate-object-field-refs.test.ts`（拒收/放行成对用例）、`packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.lookup-filter-record-path-unknown-refused.ts`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint exec vitest run src/validate-object-field-refs.test.ts`，预期 119 条全绿，其中 `$record` 一组 16 条。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- `object-field-ref-unknown` gains one member of its owner-addressed field-level sweep: `fields.NAME.lookupFilters[N].value.$record`. It is a new row of `FIELD_NAME_SLOTS` (`address: 'owner'`, path-resolved), with three new slot properties:
  - `pickerOnly` — judged only on `lookup` / `master_detail` / `user`, the types whose picker is the only reader (matching how the module treats keys with no reader).
  - `maxHops: 1` — a path with two hops is refused at the segment past the bound (`takes a second hop at "parent"`), before resolution. On the parsed path the schema regex already refuses two dots; this covers the raw `os lint` path.
  - `ownFinding` — a `$record` miss is never folded into the same entry's `.field` miss: they name fields of two different objects, so both are reported. (The fold exists for the `dependsOn` pair, where one fix answers both.)
- Resolution is the family's `resolveFieldPath` against the OWNING object: unknown head → `hop-unknown`; hop through a non-relationship → `hop-not-relationship`; leaf the referenced object lacks → `field-unknown`; a hop whose referenced object is not in the stack, or an injected-column hop (`owner_id.x`), stays unjudged — the same cross-package policy as every other position in this sweep. Registry-injected columns are valid single names (`created_at`).
- Only the WHOLE `value` is read. A `{ $record }` list member is already refused by the parse (`refuseMalformedLookupFilterEntry`, "never a member of a list"), so it is not judged a second time.
- Carried N7 (record 6903625797): a `{ $record }` nested deeper inside a literal (`value: { market: { $record: 'x' } }`) is left unnamed by lint — pinned. Reasons: no reader resolves that shape, nothing first-party writes it (measured below), the rule is error-only so naming it would need a new advisory tier, and refusing an unresolved `$record` that reaches a filter is the server door's job.
- `rule-explanations.ts`: one new paragraph for the position (`os explain object-field-ref-unknown`).
- ADR-0087 semantic entry `lookup-filter-record-path-unknown-refused`, with the measured first-party exposure.

### First-party exposure (measured at `dfb8ed35`, before the change)

`git grep -nE "[{,]\s*['\"]?\\$record['\"]?\s*:"` across the whole repo, outside `field.zod.ts` and the generated references: the only `lookupFilters` `$record` objects are the #34009 fixtures in `packages/spec/src/data/field.test.ts` and the #34009 changeset. Zero hits in `examples/**`, `packages/**/src` platform objects, `packages/apps/**`, `skills/**`, `content/docs/**` samples and `ui/**`. Verdict under the new check: nothing to judge; no shipped app's picker changes.

## Tests

`packages/lint/src/validate-object-field-refs.test.ts`, new block `lookupFilters[].value.$record` (16 cases), refused and accepted side by side:

| case | verdict |
|:--|:--|
| unknown head `acount.cb_market` | refused, `traverses "acount" … Did you mean "account"?` |
| unknown leaf `account.cb_markt` | refused, against `crm_account`, `Did you mean "cb_market"?` |
| hop through a `text` field | refused, `hop-not-relationship` |
| two hops `account.parent.cb_market` (every segment exists) | refused at `"parent"` |
| a field of the FILTERED object (`valid_from`) | refused — `$record` reads the edited record |
| clean single field + injected column (`created_at`) | passes |
| clean single hop `account.cb_market` | passes |
| hop through a `tree` field (`parent_quote.quote_date`) | passes |
| hop through a `user` field (`approver_user.department`) | passes |
| hop through an injected column (`owner_id.anything`) | silent — unjudged injected hop |
| hop to an object outside the stack | silent |
| `$record` miss + `.field` miss on one entry | two findings |
| list-member form | not judged here; the parse refuses it (pinned with `FieldSchema.safeParse`) |
| nested inside a literal (N7) | not named (pinned) |
| non-picker type | silent |
| `user` field picker | judged |

The two-hop message reads "at most one relationship hop". The two coverage-control lists (one-line verdict / one-line fix ≤ 200 chars) gain `.value.$record`; the `os explain` fact list gains the new paragraph's facts. No existing test edited otherwise.

<details><summary>Ablation (three runs through scripts/ablation-replace.mjs, each restored blob == HEAD)</summary>

- Member removed (`read: readRecordReference,` → `read: () => undefined,`): `Tests 9 failed | 107 passed (116)` — the 7 refusal cases and both coverage controls; every accepted case stayed green. Restored: blob `d0591651212e` == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- Hop bound removed (`maxHops: 1,` deleted): `Tests 1 failed | 115 passed (116)` — the two-hop case. Restored: blob == HEAD.
- Hop set narrowed to lookup / master_detail (`user` and `tree` dropped from `RELATIONSHIP_FIELD_TYPES` in `object-graph.ts`, where the set lives), at `c83d1195`: `Tests 3 failed | 116 passed (119)` — the `tree` pin, the `user` pin, and the one-line-verdict bound (the ablated `tree` verdict is 207 characters, a side effect of the mutation). Restored: blob `7216c756` == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty. The first attempt at this leg did not change the file, and the tool stopped it before the tests ran; the reading is from the second attempt, made with a distinct marker.

The test imports `./validate-object-field-refs.js` relatively (source, not `dist`), so no rebuild leg applies.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **Hop types.** The delta named `lookup` / `master_detail` heads; the implementation reuses the family's `resolveFieldPath`, whose traversable set is `lookup`, `master_detail`, `user`, `tree` (`RELATIONSHIP_FIELD_TYPES`). A `user` field is a lookup to `sys_user` and `tree` a self-lookup, each one stored foreign key. Accepted at review (record 6905932695) and pinned by the `user` / `tree` / injected-hop cases above.
- **Multi-value hop.** A hop through a `multiple: true` lookup (or a multi-value leaf) has no single value, which the `{ $record }` declaration requires. Not judged here: it is a reader question for the picker card (#34197), observation only.

## Verification

All local readings are at head `99ff6598`. That is the merge of `origin/main` `43dd5656` through `scripts/pm/os-regen-merge.sh`, with no conflicts; step 2 took main's side of the generated artifacts. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated` reports all 14 generated artifacts up to date, so nothing was regenerated.

- **PR diff unchanged by the merge.** `git diff origin/main...HEAD` matches `git diff dfb8ed35 c83d11952` line for line apart from the `index` lines: same 5 files, `+321 / -8`, the same hunk headers. Four blobs are identical. `rule-explanations.ts` has a new blob because main's #34132 edited the same file; its hunk is unchanged, and the #34132 entry (`field-label-duplicate`) is present at HEAD.
- `@objectstack/lint` `typecheck` + `test` under the lock, after a full `./packages/**` rebuild: `Test Files 212 passed (212)`, `Tests 9065 passed (9065)`.
- Full dogfood battery (the title carries `!`, Clause-② carries the `(narrowing)` arm): `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test` under the lock, in the same hold, VERDICT command-exit 0. `Test Files 470 passed | 3 skipped (473)`, `Tests 3985 passed | 42 skipped (4027)`.

<details><summary>Derived gate round at 99ff6598: dispatch-gates --commands gives 92 families; --ran gives 92 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN</summary>

All 92 exited 0 on their first run at this head.
</details>

Review: contract review PASS at `d180955e` (record 6905932695). The delta review PASSed at `c83d1195` (record 6906706417). This head adds only the main merge to that reviewed diff.
